scenes.title: SageMaker JumpStart
scenes.narration: Look at the four steps across the top. SageMaker JumpStart lets a team browse pretrained models or solution templates instead of building everything from scratch. Next, the model card and license are reviewed for training details, intended use, limitations and permission to use the model. Third, fine-tuning with your own dataset is optional. Fine-tuning means adjusting a pretrained model for a specific task, not training a completely new model from the beginning. Finally, deploy the selected model with SageMaker, using a real-time endpoint or batch inference as appropriate. The bottom customer-support example chooses a summarization model, reviews its documented restrictions, optionally fine-tunes it on support tickets and then deploys it. The license check is a real decision: model availability does not imply unrestricted commercial rights. The exam tip points to JumpStart for discovering and starting from pretrained models or solution templates, whereas Canvas is chiefly a no-code interface for building and using models.

scenes.title: Selecting a pre-trained model from JumpStart
scenes.narration: Follow this five-step selection workflow. First, browse text, vision, speech or multimodal models in SageMaker JumpStart. The second panel asks you to inspect the model card, including intended uses, limitations, training data and evaluation results, together with the license and commercial terms. The middle panel tests the candidate with an example prompt and inspects its response. The displayed request summarizes a short paragraph about JumpStart; the response is an illustrative result, not proof that the model always summarizes correctly. Step four optionally fine-tunes the model using task-specific training data and a configured training job. Step five deploys to an endpoint for application use. The lower worked example searches for a summarization model, shows FLAN-T5 as an illustrative choice, tests an article about renewable energy, reviews the summary and deploys. Check the example for factual accuracy and omissions before selecting a model. JumpStart speeds model discovery, but you still own suitability, cost, security and evaluation decisions.
